Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the familial relationship after confirming that Theudebert I (Wisigard’s husband) was the son of Theuderic I. Instead of naming Theuderic I as the father-in-law, the Planner incorrectly jumped one generation up and concluded Clovis I (Theuderic I’s father) was the father-in-law, contradicting earlier correct reasoning and the sources.
